steps.message: Merge the contents of Markor notes 2023_02_16_warm_cow.md, b9aO_gentle_fox.txt and 2023_02_28_witty_jacket.md (in the same order) into a new Markor note named E7eHCLfJ and save it. Add a new line between the content of each note.

Execute: adb shell "echo '---DIRS---'; find /storage/emulated/0 -maxdepth 4 -type d \( -iname '*markor*' -o -iname '*notes*' \) 2>/dev/null; echo '---FILES---'; find /storage/emulated/0 -type f \( -name '*warm_cow*' -o -name '*gentle_fox*' -o -name '*witty_jacket*' \) 2>/dev/null"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "echo '---DIRS---'; find /storage/emulated/0 -maxdepth 4 -type d \( -iname '*markor*' -o -iname '*notes*' \) 2>/dev/null; echo '---FILES---'; find /storage/emulated/0 -type f \( -name '*warm_cow*' -o -name '*gentle_fox*' -o -name '*witty_jacket*' \) 2>/dev/null""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d file:///storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/E7eHCLfJ >/dev/null 2>&1; echo scanned"
